headline: Continued 865 South Prospect Street permit, approved 275-277 Flynn Avenue subdivision, deferred 45 Howard Street addition, and appointed new DRB Chair and Vice Chair.
summary: The board continued a home occupation permit at 865 South Prospect Street and approved a two-lot subdivision at 275-277 Flynn Avenue. It deferred a Certificate of Appropriateness for 45 Howard Street and closed hearings on a food stand permit at 56 Woodbury Road and a tree-clearing case at 246 Riverside Ave for later deliberation. The board also held its annual organizational meeting, appointing a new Chair, Vice Chair, and committee representatives.
decisions: Continued the ZP-26-252 application for 865 South Prospect Street to the 8/4/26 DRB meeting, vote 5-0.
Approved the ZP-26-133 two-lot subdivision at 275-277 Flynn Avenue, vote 5-0.
Deferred the ZP-26-28 Certificate of Appropriateness for 45 Howard Street to the 8/4/26 DRB meeting, vote 5-0.
Appointed Caitlin Halpert as Chair of the Development Review Board, vote 6-0.
Appointed Evan Gould as Vice Chair of the Development Review Board, vote 6-0.
Appointed Evan Gould as representative to the Long Range Planning Committee, vote 6-0.
Appointed Miles Waite as representative to the Planning Commission Ordinance Committee, vote 6-0.

## BURLINGTON DEVELOPMENT REVIEW BOARD
Tuesday, July 21, 2026, 5:00 PM
MINUTES

*Hybrid & In Person (at 645 Pine Street) Meeting*

**Board Members Present:** AJ LaRosa, Caitlin Halpert, Evan Gould (5:05 PM), Sean McKenzie, Miles Waite, and Marina Campbell (5:10 PM)

**Board Members Absent:** Geoff Hand and Chase Taylor

**Staff Members Present:** Scott Gustin, Kirk Dressing, and Joseph Cava

**Staff Members Absent:** Mary O'Neil and Matthew Clark

I. Agenda
II. Communications
III. Minutes
IV. Consent

1. **ZP-26-252; 865 South Prospect Street (RL, Ward 6) Stephanie Seguino**
Proposed commercial kitchen home occupation. (Project Manager, Kirk Dressing)

AJ LaRosa: Is the applicant present?

Scott Gustin: Is the applicant online? You might want to circle back to this application, AJ.

Miles Waite: The applicant should be here to speak.

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to continue to the 8/4/26 DRB meeting, Miles Waite 2nd. Vote 5-0. Motion carried.

2. **ZP-26-133; 275-277 Flynn Avenue (RL, Ward 5) Kurt Schueler**
Proposed 2-lot subdivision. No development included. (Project Manager, Kirk Dressing)
Kurt Schueler, owner, present.

AJ LaRosa: Is the applicant present, and have you had the chance to review the staff report and have any questions or comments?

Kurt Schueler: Yes, and no questions or comments.

AJ LaRosa: Would anyone on the Board have an issue with treating this item as consent? Hearing none, are there any questions or comments from members of the Board? Hearing none, are there any questions or comments from members of the public in attendance or online wishing to speak on this item? Hearing none, would someone like to make a motion?

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to approve and adopt staff findings and recommendations, Caitlin Halpert 2nd. Vote 5-0. Motion carried.

V. Public Hearing

1. **ZP-26-266; 56 Woodbury Road (RL, Ward 4) David Tomlinson**
Proposed seasonal (May – October) food stand home occupation. (Project Manager, Scott Gustin)
David Tomlinson, owner, present.

AJ LaRosa: Is the applicant present, and have you had the chance to review the staff report and have any questions or comments?

David Tomlinson: Yes, and no questions or comments.

Scott Gustin: The only outstanding item is the business of on-site parking. The Board can decide how they would like to proceed without that.

David Tomlinson: I would like to set up a tent on my front lawn to sell pre-packaged food goods. Regarding parking, my driveway can accommodate additional vehicles, but parking would be limited to two spaces as a disclaimer. There is a question between people stopping on the side of the road versus parking in the driveway.

AJ LaRosa: I do not foresee that this type of business would accumulate a line of vehicles. If I look at this under the regulations of 5a, the tent will be put up regularly.

David Tomlinson: Correct, I will be setting up a tent on the weekends.

Scott Gustin: When there is ambiguity in the ordinance's language, the results find in favor of the applicant.

AJ LaRosa: Do you understand the intention?

David Tomlinson: Yes, I do. There will likely be a sign that says cookies on the side of the tent, but at most, there would only be a sandwich board sign by the road.

Scott Gustin: Political signs are allowed, but the language is ambiguous regarding signage for home occupations.

AJ LaRosa: Are there any questions or comments from members of the public in attendance or online wishing to speak on this item? Hearing none, we will close the hearing on this item and deliberate on it later on.

VI. Certificate of Appropriateness

1. **ZP-26-28; 45 Howard Street (RM, Ward 5) Sarah Schiesser / Thomas Wironen / Robert Hale**
Proposed construction of an addition to the west side of existing single-family home. Original historic home will be repainted and repaired in kind. (Project Manager, Mary O'Neil)

Scott Gustin: There is a request to defer this item to a later meeting date.

AJ LaRosa: Is there anyone present in person or online to speak on this item? Hearing none, is there anyone on this Board that would object to deferring this item?

Miles Waite: Motioned to defer to the 8/4/26 DRB meeting, AJ LaRosa 2nd. Vote 5-0. Motion carried.

2. **ZP-26-231; 246 Riverside Ave (NAC-R, Ward 1) Gedoola, LLC / Eric Jacobs**
After-the-fact tree clearing. (Project Manager, Kirk Dressing)
Sharon Bushor, Edwin Merrill, and Ginger Camp: Sworn in.

AJ LaRosa: Is the applicant present?

Scott Gustin: The applicant does not appear to be present in person or online.

AJ LaRosa: Are there any questions or comments from members of the Board? Hearing none, are there any questions or comments from members of the public in attendance or online wishing to speak on this item?

Sharon Bushor: My concern is the state of the property and how it will be resolved. I understand that the applicant has failed to attend the required meeting twice now. I am concerned about runoff and further action that is needed to remedy the situation. There is a perpetual continuation of people doing things first without approval, and then asking for forgiveness later. This has created an especially dangerous situation for residents living on the hillside.

AJ LaRosa: Enforcement action by the City will likely be taken.

Edwin Merrill: I am concerned about the existing slope's stability. The owner has not provided any information to support the improvement of slope stability. A geotechnical report was done in 2020, and if we receive a heavy rain, there is a risk that Building Four at the edge of the slope will not be protected. A tree inventory was uploaded, but it does not clarify the diameter beyond the quantity of trees removed.

Miles Waite: Do you disagree or disapprove of the inventory?

Edwin Merrill: The lack of supporting information was a shock.

Ginger Camp: Edwin shared most of my concerns, but I also shared additional concerns and a geotechnical report with William Ward.

AJ LaRosa: I am sure Scott or Kirk will look for this shared file.

AJ LaRosa: Are there any additional questions or comments concerning this item? Hearing none, we will close the hearing on this item and deliberate on it later on.

VII. Other Business

1. **Annual Organizational Meeting**
Nomination and election of Chair, Vice Chair, and reps to Ordinance and Long Range Planning Committees.

Sean McKenzie: Motioned to appoint Caitlin Halpert as Chair of the Development Review Board, AJ LaRosa 2nd. Vote 6-0. Motion carried.

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to appoint Evan Gould as Vice Chair of the Development Review Board, Caitlin Halpert 2nd. Vote 6-0. Motion carried.

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to appoint Evan Gould as representative to the Long Range Planning Committee, Caitlin Halpert 2nd. Vote 6-0. Motion carried.

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to appoint Miles Waite as representative to the Planning Commission Ordinance Committee, Caitlin Halpert 2nd. Vote 6-0. Motion carried.

VIII. Adjournment
Hearing closed at 5:30 PM.

Caitlin Halpert, Chair of Development Review Board — Date: 8/18/26

Joseph H. Cava, Permitting & Inspections Permit Technician — Date: 8-18-26
